description: A simulated financial-news specialist: near-expert on Business articles (recognized via a large finance/markets vocabulary), but weak and close to random on World, Sports, and Sci/Tech, where it has no comparable domain vocabulary to draw on.
design_rationale: Expert reads each article using a weaker MultinomialNB + keyword model, infers a latent topic from text, then samples a label from a class-conditional confusion matrix calibrated on validation. True labels are never used at inference.
